title: Dryer purge valve not seating — Compressor stays loaded and does not reach cut-out
cause: The purge valve of the desiccant dryer does not close between changeovers.
checks: Listen at the purge silencer while the unit is loaded.
remedy: Overhaul or replace the purge valve and its pilot line.

evidence.observation: Dryer purge pressure has stayed far above its resting value between changeovers.
